## Context / immutable basis
Exactly 63 bloated prose blocks are confirmed in 13 paths under tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/. Condense redundant or historical text while retaining current non-obvious contracts.

Inventory and before-citations are pinned to origin/main@d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84. All impacted blobs match the clean audit worktree at 10533b1e3f651a60e8cea5691318c108ff1f3396. Implement from current origin/main; keep d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84 as the immutable before side. The leaf is one commit (HEAD^..HEAD).

## Boundary and guards
Edit only the anchored ordinary comments/docstrings below and adjacent blank lines. Currentize RED, pre-fix, “Today”, and implementation-scaffolding prose. Executable statements, assertions, runtime strings, directives, and unlisted prose stay unchanged.

Parse base/final files with ast.parse(source, type_comments=True); strip only leading Expr(Constant(str)) nodes from Module/ClassDef/FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef bodies; normalize only ast.TypeIgnore.lineno; require exact ast.dump(..., include_attributes=False) equality. Tokenizer comparison preserves exact directive text/attachment; runtime strings remain AST-identical.

## Scope — 63 editable blocks
- test_config_jira_wiring.py (4) — module and test_{non_https_jira_url_fails_loud_not_env_fallback,dc_resolver_also_fails_loud_on_non_https_jira_url,bootstrap_env_check_requires_resolved_url_user_token}. Preserve typed-config consumption, HTTPS fail-closed behavior, and bootstrap parity.
- test_config.py (6) — module; test_{jira_to_local_status_canonical_preimages,jira_to_local_status_round_trips_through_forward_map,jira_to_local_status_parity_with_inbound_differ,local_to_jira_status_parity_with_the_jira_family_map}; comment beginning “Loaded BY PATH”. Replace pre-fix history with current canonical-map parity and import-boundary rationale.
- test_corrupt_state_guard.py (9) — module; TestBindingStoreCorrupt.{test_corrupt_json_raises_with_named_file,test_git_conflict_markers_in_bindings_raises,test_corrupt_bindings_no_empty_fallback}; TestPrevSnapshotCorrupt plus its test_{prev_snapshot_json_parse_error_helper,corrupt_prev_snapshot_must_not_emit_comment_adds}; TestHealthyStateRegression.test_healthy_snapshot_deduplicates_comments; comment beginning “Defense-in-depth”. Preserve fail-closed state handling and no blind comment emission.
- test_errors.py (2) — comment beginning “The 9 canonical applier leaf names” and test_authorized_writers_docstring_documents_full_contract. Its concise module docstring is excluded.
- test_peer_state.py (1) — module. Preserve standalone peer-state round-trip/default behavior.
- test_reconcile_helpers_standalone_git_adapter.py (1) — module. Preserve by-file loading, locked git commit behavior, and non-repository degradation.
- test_ref_lock_push_classification.py (9) — module; comments beginning “Bug ebee” and “The split of the push/CAS cluster”; test_{non_cas_rejections_are_not_reported_as_a_stolen_lease,cas_mismatch_logs_the_stderr_that_justified_it,a_github_server_side_ref_failure_is_not_reported_as_a_stolen_lease,the_git_patch_point_survives_the_module_split,the_cas_verdict_still_logs_on_the_ref_lock_logger,moved_names_stay_resolvable_at_the_original_module_path}. Preserve lease re-observation, evidence logging, patch points, logger identity, and compatibility exports.
- test_ref_lock.py (2) — module and _bare_git. Preserve bare-ref CAS behavior and explicit git-dir isolation.
- test_rich_reemit_state.py (18) — module; test_{rich_sha_takes_cloud_adf_dicts_and_ignores_key_order,an_entry_mutation_survives_the_store_save_reload_round_trip,the_core_flag_read_agrees_with_the_codecs,the_observation_reaches_the_baseline_through_advance_baselines,narrow_operation_persists_the_same_bytes_as_the_legacy_sequence,a_missing_binding_is_nonfatal_and_distinguishable,the_operation_performs_no_save_at_either_layer,the_production_push_never_reaches_a_binding_through_all_bindings,the_production_push_records_through_the_narrow_operation,a_missing_binding_still_skips_the_read_back_after_the_cutover,the_call_site_makes_no_false_claim_about_the_facade,no_production_module_outside_the_read_allowlist_calls_all_bindings}; _AllBindingsWatcher; _production_all_bindings_callers; comments beginning “RP-02 S2 T3”, “9. RP-02 S3 T3”, and “Production modules permitted”. Preserve digest/counter equivalence, sole-writer/no-save boundaries, missing-binding sentinel, and AST caller census.
- test_richtext_port_heldout.py (2) — module and test_fit_comment_truncates_over_limit_byte_identical. Preserve send-path truncation and neutrality.
- test_richtext_port.py (1) — module. Preserve neutral-core rich-text/limit port wiring.
- test_run_differs_wires_refresh_scoped_snapshot_79a4.py (4) — module, _empty_ctx, test_run_differs_invokes_refresh_scoped_snapshot_once_with_ctx, test_refresh_scoped_snapshot_runs_before_the_snapshot_differ. Preserve once-only call and pre-differ ordering.
- test_scoped_snapshot_overlay_f449.py (4) — module, test_overlay_preserves_snapshot_enrichment_keys, test_stale_snapshot_would_clobber_without_the_overlay, comment beginning “6. the ORCHESTRATOR refresh_scoped_snapshot”. Preserve enrichment merge, stale-snapshot contrast, and wrapper guards.

## Consumers and directives
Pytest collects every module; check_comment_hygiene.py consumes repository prose. test_errors.py inspects production applier/rebar-id authorization documentation: only its own test prose is editable, while executable assertions and production docstrings remain exact. No targeted consumer of an editable docstring was found.

Preserve exactly 26 directive tokens and attachments: config (4 union-attr); corrupt-state (union-attr plus complete E501 and BLE001 noqa tokens); errors (1 union-attr); ref-lock classification (complete BLE001 noqa); ref-lock (1 union-attr); rich-reemit (one import-bootstrap pragma and nine E402 noqas); run-differs (one pragma, one union-attr); scoped-overlay (two pragmas and two E402 noqas).

## Independent receipt
A non-author reviewer posts exactly 63 leaf-linked TSV rows:
path<TAB>anchor/kind<TAB>before-citation<TAB>after-citation<TAB>preserved-contract-or-consumer<TAB>before-words<TAB>after-words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer-session

Citations use full SHAs, every after count is lower, and both verdicts are PASS. Missing, duplicate, or extra rows block closure.

- [ ] Every changed block is shorter.
- [ ] Every changed block states only current rationale or constraints.

- [ ] `semantic` exits 0.

- [ ] `diff` exits 0.
- [ ] `hygiene` exits 0.

- [ ] Untimed `full` exits 0.
- [ ] The non-author TSV has exactly 63 rows.

- [ ] Every row cites the full immutable-base SHA.
- [ ] Every row cites the full final SHA.
- [ ] Every row records `after_words < before_words`.

- [ ] Every row names a non-author reviewer session.

## Verification
Run all seven structured commands: semantic, directives, paths, diff, hygiene, focused, full.
